prerequisites: successful completion of the penultimate semester of study

learning_outcomes.text: Students demonstrate that they master the fundamental methodologies of an engineering task; this is tested, among other things, with questions on the processing of the Bachelor's thesis and general subject-specific questions.

syllabus_topics: Mastery of the basic principles and most important facts from the teaching content of the Mechanical Engineering degree program and the Bachelor's thesis
assessment_rules: Students' knowledge is graded based on a 20-minute presentation followed by a 40-minute oral examination.
